dict.string: Se needs local network access so commands you run in a terminal can reach devices and services on your network, such as development servers on other machines.
Se needs access to your Desktop folder to browse project files and run commands there.
Se needs access to your Documents folder to browse project files and run commands there.
Se needs access to your Downloads folder to browse project files and run commands there.
Se needs access to removable volumes so projects stored on external drives can be opened.
Se needs access to network volumes so projects stored on network shares can be opened.
Se needs access to cloud-synced folders so projects stored there can be opened.
Se needs permission to control other apps so scripts and commands you run can automate them.
Se needs administration access so commands you run can perform privileged system tasks.
Se needs screen recording permission so commands you run can capture the screen.
Se needs camera access only when a command you run requests it. Se itself does not use the camera.
Se needs microphone access only when a command you run requests it. Se itself does not record audio.
Se needs speech recognition only when a command you run requests it.
Se needs calendar access only when a command you run requests it.
Se needs reminders access only when a command you run requests it.
Se needs contacts access only when a command you run requests it.
Se needs photo library access only when a command you run requests it.
Se needs Bluetooth access only when a command you run requests it.
Se needs location access only when a command you run requests it.
Se needs motion data only when a command you run requests it.
